purpose: Separate mechanical cut-candidate polarity from confidence ordering after the first mutex-watershed court proved global consistency but remained recall/precision limited.

STRETCH_OR_L1_JSD.repulsive: in-scope dense edge with max_stretch>4 OR Arachne_L1>1

STRETCH_AND_L1_JSD.repulsive: in-scope dense edge with max_stretch>4 AND Arachne_L1>1

solver: Same deterministic mutex-watershed implementation for every variant.
teacher_policy: All three partitions are frozen before any teacher topology is loaded. Teacher topology is evaluation-only; teacher weights are post-inference topology-mechanics isolation only.
selection_rule: No post-hoc hidden selection. Every variant and every frozen closure gate is reported.
